fields.name: community_name_official
fields.purpose: Identifies the community and anchors every source search.
fields.downstream: Source retrieval; the code-to-name key held privately for T12.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing — a community with no findable name is not enumerable.

fields.name: alternative_names
fields.purpose: Former names, local names, transliterations and network variants.
fields.downstream: Each variant is a separate academic and archive search string. Directly raises Stage 5/6 yield, which is where rank-1 onset evidence lives.
fields.missing: Write 'not found'. Search yield is lower; record it in negative_consultations.

fields.name: country
fields.purpose: Nation-state the site sits in.
fields.downstream: Stage 2 matching criterion (same country, holding policy and tenure constant); T1 sample description; country income group in T12.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing — it is derivable from the coordinates.

fields.name: admin_region
fields.purpose: Province, state or county.
fields.downstream: SC12 leave-region-out reference anchoring; reporting where Tier 2 and Tier 3 quartets cluster (T2).
fields.missing: Derive from the coordinates and record that you did.

fields.name: coordinate_agreement
fields.purpose: Whether published sources place the community where the held coordinates do.
fields.downstream: The polygon, the rings, the reference circle and every extraction are drawn about the held coordinates. A wrong centre invalidates all of them.
fields.missing: 'no published location' is a valid value and is not a gap.

fields.name: e1_network_listing
fields.purpose: Which networks or directories list the community.
fields.downstream: Inclusion criterion E1. Also supplies the directory whose archive gives last_listing_year.
fields.missing: If nothing lists it, e1_pathway must be 'independent self-identification'.

fields.name: e1_pathway
fields.purpose: How the community qualifies under E1.
fields.downstream: Inclusion record. Makes the sample definition auditable.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing; if neither route holds the community is ineligible.

fields.name: e1_self_identification
fields.purpose: A published phrase, under 25 words, stating ecological aims.
fields.downstream: The evidence for E1. Without it, eligibility is an assertion.
fields.missing: Where none exists, eligibility rests on B1 alone; record that.

fields.name: e2_settlement_type
fields.purpose: What kind of entity the site is.
fields.downstream: Exclusion criterion E2. Retreat centres, single households, businesses and urban co-housing leave the sample. The highest-consequence categorical in Stage 1.
fields.missing: 'unclear' keeps the community in and flags it; report how many.

fields.name: e2_evidence_note
fields.purpose: One line stating why B4 was coded as it was.
fields.downstream: Makes the exclusion decision auditable and double-codeable.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing where B4 is coded.

fields.name: e8_setting_at_onset
fields.purpose: Rural or peri-urban at onset, rather than urban.
fields.downstream: Exclusion criterion E8; Stage 2 matches on rural classification.
fields.missing: 'unclear' keeps the community in and flags it.

fields.name: date_formal_founding
fields.purpose: Year the community was established as an entity.
fields.downstream: Distinguishes founding from onset, which is the study's central dating rule; supplies founding_decade, a named confounder in A4.
fields.missing: 'not found'. founding_decade is then blank and A4 loses one named confounder.

fields.name: date_land_acquisition
fields.purpose: Year the land was bought, leased or occupied.
fields.downstream: The hardest available lower bound on onset: intervention cannot precede tenure. It is the field that makes onset_lower_bound defensible rather than guessed.
fields.missing: 'not found'. onset_lower_bound then rests on evidence rank alone and should be widened.

fields.name: date_intervention_onset
fields.purpose: Year the first deliberate action to alter vegetation, soil, water or land cover for ecological purposes is documented. NOT the founding year.
fields.downstream: ONSET_AGE in A4; cohort membership in A7; the age smooth carried as a confounder in A8; onset decade in T1; T12 context.
fields.missing: 'not found'. The site leaves A4 and cannot enter the cohort. It stays in every other analysis.

fields.name: onset_lower_bound
fields.purpose: Earliest plausible onset year.
fields.downstream: A4 propagates the band by multiple imputation, so a community with a wide band contributes less than one with a narrow band.
fields.missing: Where C3 is 'not found', leave blank; the site is out of A4 anyway.

fields.name: onset_upper_bound
fields.purpose: Latest plausible onset year.
fields.downstream: As C4.
fields.missing: As C4.

fields.name: onset_evidence_rank
fields.purpose: Strength of the onset evidence, 1 strongest to 5 weakest.
fields.downstream: Sets the expected band width; reported in T12; the basis on which conflicting sources are resolved.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing where C3 is coded.

fields.name: onset_evidence_description
fields.purpose: One line saying what the evidence actually is.
fields.downstream: Makes the rank auditable and double-codeable.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing where C3 is coded.

fields.name: onset_conflicting_sources
fields.purpose: Where sources disagree, what each says.
fields.downstream: Absolute rule: a source conflict is never resolved silently. Feeds the resolution rule and the disagreement log.
fields.missing: 'none' is a valid and common value.

fields.name: onset_proxy_flag
fields.purpose: Whether C3 is a founding year used as a substitute for an onset year.
fields.downstream: A proxy onset is excluded from A4. This flag is the exclusion switch.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing; default 'no' only when C3 is genuinely an onset.

fields.name: onset_confidence_tier
fields.purpose: A precise, B plus or minus one year, C uncertain beyond that.
fields.downstream: Cohort admission: A7 admits tier A and B only. Decision D4 counts on it.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing where C3 is coded.

fields.name: onset_first_or_major
fields.purpose: Whether the onset is the community's first intervention or a later major project at an established community.
fields.downstream: The cohort must either restrict to first interventions or report the two groups separately; they are different treatments.
fields.missing: 'unclear' is valid; report how many.

fields.name: cohort_candidate
fields.purpose: Whether onset falls in the cohort window.
fields.downstream: Assembles the longitudinal cohort; drives the running tally behind decision D4.
fields.missing: 'uncertain' must be resolved before decision D4.

fields.name: v1_self_documentation
fields.purpose: The community describes particular actions rather than aims.
fields.downstream: Channel 1 of evidence_tier.
fields.missing: 'no' where only aims are stated.

fields.name: v2_external_documentation
fields.purpose: An academic account, thesis, project record, certification, grant award or media coverage of the work exists.
fields.downstream: Channel 2, and the channel that distinguishes tier A. Carries SC18.
fields.missing: 'no' is the expected value for most communities.

fields.name: v3_substantive_affiliation
fields.purpose: Membership of a body that assesses practice, named.
fields.downstream: Channel 3.
fields.missing: 'no'.

fields.name: v4_visual_documentation
fields.purpose: Dated photographs, site plans, design drawings or maps exist.
fields.downstream: Channel 4.
fields.missing: 'no'.

fields.name: v5_continuity_evidence
fields.purpose: The work is described consistently across years.
fields.downstream: Channel 5.
fields.missing: 'no'.

fields.name: population_value
fields.purpose: Permanent residents only. Not visitors, volunteers or students.
fields.downstream: Stage 2 matching criterion (population within a factor of three); a model covariate; a named confounder in A4 and A8; population band in T1 and T12.
fields.missing: 'not found'. The quartet is matched on the remaining criteria and flagged; report how many.

fields.name: population_lower
fields.purpose: Lower end where a source gives a range.
fields.downstream: Bounds the matching tolerance where the point value is soft.
fields.missing: Blank where the source gives a single figure.

fields.name: population_upper
fields.purpose: Upper end where a source gives a range.
fields.downstream: As E2.
fields.missing: Blank where the source gives a single figure.

fields.name: population_source_date
fields.purpose: The year the population figure refers to.
fields.downstream: A 2009 figure and a 2024 figure are not in conflict; without the year the matching tolerance is applied to an unknown quantity.
fields.missing: 'not found'. Treat the figure as undated and widen the tolerance.

fields.name: managed_area_ha
fields.purpose: Land the community actively works ecologically, in hectares. NOT the total holding.
fields.downstream: The only independent check on the drawn polygon. Feeds area_ratio, area_agreement_tier, table T10 and the SC16 restriction.
fields.missing: 'not found'. area_agreement_tier becomes B and the polygon stands unaffected. This is a complete and correct answer.

fields.name: managed_area_lower_ha
fields.purpose: Lowest plausible worked area the sources support.
fields.downstream: A source saying 'about 15 ha' and a polygon of 11 ha are not in conflict; a source saying '15.4 ha under cultivation' and the same polygon are. The band is what makes the check meaningful.
fields.missing: Blank where the source gives a firm single figure.

fields.name: managed_area_upper_ha
fields.purpose: Highest plausible worked area.
fields.downstream: As E6.
fields.missing: Blank where the source gives a firm single figure.

fields.name: managed_area_basis
fields.purpose: How the documentary figure was arrived at.
fields.downstream: Weights the corroboration. A 'measured' figure disagreeing with the polygon means something different from a 'stated' one disagreeing.
fields.missing: 'not found' where E5 is 'not found'.

fields.name: managed_area_source_class
fields.purpose: Which source class supplied the area figure.
fields.downstream: Records whether the only external check on the geometry is itself the community's own voice.
fields.missing: Blank where E5 is 'not found'.

fields.name: documentary_area_note
fields.purpose: Anything qualifying the figure: whether it plainly refers to worked land or to the whole holding, whether it covers one parcel or several, and the year it refers to.
fields.downstream: The text a tier C investigation is resolved from.
fields.missing: Blank where E5 is 'not found'.

fields.name: total_holding_ha
fields.purpose: The whole landholding.
fields.downstream: Exists so that the total holding is never silently substituted for the worked area, and so a tier C disagreement can be explained. A community holding 200 ha and working 15 ha has managed_area_ha = 15.
fields.missing: 'not found'.

fields.name: area_type
fields.purpose: Which of the two area figures the sources actually give.
fields.downstream: Distinguishes 'the community says it works 15 ha' from 'the community says it holds 200 ha and says nothing about what it works'.
fields.missing: 'not stated'.

fields.name: parcel_structure
fields.purpose: One block or several.
fields.downstream: A non-contiguous holding is the legitimate reason a documentary area can exceed the polygon area: the polygon excludes detached parcels more than 500 m from the centre. Without it, that case is indistinguishable from a total-holding confusion.
fields.missing: 'unknown'.

fields.name: status_current
fields.purpose: Present state of the community.
fields.downstream: Eligibility criterion E5; the survivorship limitation; T1 sample description. Dissolved sites are analysed separately.
fields.missing: 'unknown'. UNKNOWN IS NOT DISSOLVED.

fields.name: status_evidence
fields.purpose: What the status rests on.
fields.downstream: Dissolution requires positive evidence. This field is that evidence.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing where F1 is coded.

fields.name: last_listing_year
fields.purpose: Most recent year the community appears in any directory or archive.
fields.downstream: The dating evidence behind status_current; the input to the attrition estimate in the survivorship section.
fields.missing: 'not found'.

fields.name: dissolution_year
fields.purpose: If dissolved, when.
fields.downstream: Places a dissolved community on the timeline for the separate analysis.
fields.missing: 'n/a' unless F1 = dissolved.

fields.name: delisting_reason
fields.purpose: Why the community left a directory.
fields.downstream: Separates dissolution from relocation and administrative removal, which is the discipline that stops a vanished website becoming a vanished community.
fields.missing: 'n/a' where the community is still listed.

fields.name: external_funding_or_programme
fields.purpose: Any documented state, NGO or grant-funded restoration programme at the site.
fields.downstream: Stage 2 exclusion criterion: a control with a documented external restoration programme is excluded, and at a settlement such a programme is a second intervention running in parallel. Also frequently rank-1 onset evidence.
fields.missing: 'none found'.

fields.name: protected_area_status
fields.purpose: Inside or adjacent to a protected area.
fields.downstream: Stage 2 exclusion criterion: controls inside protected areas are excluded.
fields.missing: 'unclear'; the quartet is flagged.

fields.name: notable_context
fields.purpose: War, drought, land dispute, major fire or relocation AFFECTING LAND COVER INSIDE THE STUDY WINDOW. Not a general history field.
fields.downstream: Resolution of flagged outliers in DP10, where an extreme value must be classed as a data error, an undetected disturbance or a genuine extreme.
fields.missing: 'none found'.

fields.name: pages_opened_count
fields.purpose: Distinct URLs actually opened, including those yielding nothing.
fields.downstream: Effort audit. Separates a thin record from a thin search.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

fields.name: source_classes_found
fields.purpose: Which of S1-S8 were located.
fields.downstream: Shows at a glance whether anything outside the community's own voice was found.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

fields.name: search_languages
fields.purpose: Which languages were searched.
fields.downstream: A community that publishes only in its own language and was searched only in English produces an absence of effort, not an absence of evidence.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

fields.name: negative_consultations
fields.purpose: Source classes and databases checked and found empty.
fields.downstream: The field that makes 'evidence absent' distinguishable from 'not looked for'. Required by the three-state success criterion.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

fields.name: documents_opened
fields.purpose: PDFs, spreadsheets and other files opened, by title.
fields.downstream: Documents carry most rank-1 and rank-2 onset evidence; this records whether any were reached.
fields.missing: 'none' is valid.

fields.name: academic_search_log
fields.purpose: Which databases searched, how many hits, how many opened in full text versus abstract only. UNPACKS INTO Search_Log ROWS, one per database.
fields.downstream: The negative consultation record for Stage 5, which is now the highest-priority evidence route.
fields.missing: Rows must exist even where every database returned nothing.

fields.name: grey_literature_log
fields.purpose: Grey sources found, by type. UNPACKS INTO Search_Log ROWS.
fields.downstream: The negative consultation record for Stage 6.
fields.missing: Rows must exist even where nothing was found.

fields.name: source_set_supplied
fields.purpose: Every address supplied: URL, platform type, independence group, crawl status, pages opened. UNPACKS INTO Source_Set ROWS.
fields.downstream: Proves each supplied address was opened separately rather than collapsed into one.
fields.missing: Every supplied address must appear with a status.

fields.name: source_set_discovered
fields.purpose: Every address found during the crawl that was not supplied. UNPACKS INTO Source_Set ROWS.
fields.downstream: Former domains hold the oldest material and are the best open-web dating source. This is where onset yield usually comes from.
fields.missing: 'none discovered' is valid.

fields.name: independence_groups
fields.purpose: How many distinct independence groups the sources fall into.
fields.downstream: channel_count and evidence_tier are built on groups, never on URLs. Also the number behind any claim that sources corroborate each other.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

fields.name: stages_completed
fields.purpose: Which of stages 0-9 were completed, cut short, or never reached.
fields.downstream: Turns a silent half-search into a recorded one.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

fields.name: crawl_truncated
fields.purpose: Did the run stop before the protocol was finished?
fields.downstream: Without it, a community searched for four minutes and a community searched exhaustively that genuinely has nothing look identical in the data. They mean opposite things.
fields.missing: Cannot be missing.

derived.name: channel_count
derived.purpose: How many of V1-V5 are satisfied.
derived.missing: Computed; blank until V1-V5 are entered.

derived.name: evidence_tier
derived.purpose: A = 3 or more channels including at least one external; B = 2 channels including at least one of visual or continuity; C = 2 community-originated channels; Fail = fewer than 2. AN EVIDENCE-QUALITY VARIABLE, NOT AN ECOLOGICAL-PERFORMANCE VARIABLE.
derived.downstream: Named confounder in A4; sample description T1 and T5; the restriction in SC18; T12 context.
derived.missing: Computed; blank until V1-V5 are entered.

derived.name: onset_band_width_years
derived.downstream: The width A4's multiple imputation draws over.
derived.missing: Blank until both bounds are entered.

derived.name: below_minimum_flag
derived.purpose: 'yes' where the polygon is under 1.0 ha.
derived.downstream: Sends the site to a 75 m circle and flags it.

derived.name: reference_circle
derived.purpose: Which of the five reference-circle sizes the site is rescaled against, whichever is closest in AREA to the polygon.
derived.downstream: Rescaling. A site rescaled against a reference distribution computed on the wrong unit size is biased, invisibly.

derived.name: equal_area_circle_radius_m
derived.purpose: Radius of the circle whose area equals the polygon's: sqrt(A/pi).
derived.downstream: The alternative measurement geometry for SC1, generated rather than hand-computed.

derived.name: area_ratio
derived.purpose: documentary managed area divided by polygon area.
derived.downstream: Input to area_agreement_tier and to table T10.
derived.missing: Blank where either figure is absent.

derived.name: area_agreement_tier
derived.purpose: A = within 30 per cent; B = no documentary figure, or a gap of 30 to 100 per cent; C = a gap beyond a factor of two.
derived.downstream: The SC16 restriction. The polygon stands in every case; the tier records how well corroborated it is.
derived.missing: A site with a polygon and no documentary figure is tier B, NEVER blank.

researcher.name: site_id
researcher.purpose: The study's sole key. Names are not unique; identifiers must be.
researcher.downstream: Every join in DP8. A key mismatch drops rows silently.

researcher.name: latitude
researcher.downstream: The centre of the polygon, the rings and the common circle.

researcher.name: polygon_area_ha
researcher.purpose: Area enclosed by the hand-drawn outline of the managed ground.
researcher.downstream: THE PRIMARY MEASUREMENT GEOMETRY. Picks the reference circle; the predictor in A8; the translated control geometry.
researcher.missing: Cannot be missing. Every settlement is drawn.

researcher.name: polygon_file_id
researcher.purpose: The exported shapefile or GeoJSON feature id.
researcher.downstream: The Earth Engine table asset join. A mismatch fails the DP8 join.

researcher.name: polygon_imagery_date
researcher.purpose: Capture date of the imagery drawn on.
researcher.downstream: Imagery outside the study window may show an extent that did not exist during it.

researcher.name: polygon_confidence
researcher.purpose: How clear the managed boundary was: clear, moderate or poor.
researcher.downstream: Reported beside the redraw overlap in the reliability table.

researcher.name: polygon_redrawn
researcher.purpose: Whether this site is in the 20 per cent redraw subsample.

researcher.name: redraw_area_ha
researcher.purpose: Area of the second, independent drawing.

researcher.name: polygon_iou
researcher.purpose: Shared area divided by combined area between the two drawings.
researcher.downstream: THE reliability statistic for the study's primary measurement. Reported as its own table. A mean below 0.80 makes SC1 the primary specification.

researcher.name: agreement_note
researcher.purpose: What was found when a tier C disagreement was investigated.
researcher.downstream: Absolute rule: a source conflict is never resolved silently.

researcher.name: controls_translated
researcher.purpose: Whether the polygon has been translated onto all three controls.
researcher.downstream: A control measured over a circle while its settlement is measured over a drawn shape would produce a difference from geometry alone.
researcher.missing: Cannot be missing at Stage 1 close.

never_search: SRTM aspect and land-cover boundary orientation
The researcher's own drawing. Never estimated from imagery by anyone else
How far each control sits from its settlement
A Stage 2 matching output, not documentary coding
hypotheses: Settlements score HIGHER than their matched controls on vegetation condition
Settlements are NOT LOWER than their controls on provisioning capacity, within a declared margin
The settlement advantage is larger near the centre and smaller further out
The advantage is larger at settlements that began intervening longer ago
The advantage holds when only management-diagnostic metrics are used
The advantage is not explained by low settlement density alone
Among communities whose work began in 2020-2021, vegetation condition IMPROVES over the four years after onset relative to matched controls, with no divergence in the three years BEFORE onset
The settlement advantage varies with how much land a community works, BEYOND what measurement dilution alone predicts
